newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise as yen eases vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise as yen eases vs dlr.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer across the board on Monday, as the yen's fall against the dollar late in the day led to some moderate buying, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.5 yen to 2.8 yen per kg higher. Benchmark August was up 2.2 yen at 152.4 yen.

The market opened mostly firmer and strengthened later in reaction to the dollar's rise against the yen. One trader said diminished worries over oversupply in the near-term also supported nearby months.
